# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is fair-haired with long, sleek curls that she keeps perfectly neat. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a mouth often set in a precise, decorous expression. She presents a neat, genteel, and starched appearance, typically wearing immaculate clothes such as a crisp white dress with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Lucy is exceptionally well-behaved, calm, sensible, and dependable. She approaches her tasks with quiet care, system, and precision, showing great decorum and self-control even during frightening storms or stressful events. Although her rigid decorum and unvarying nature can make her seem quiet or unemotional, she is perceptive, helpful, mature, and deeply submissive in her duties.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## History

Following her mother's death, Lucy and her twin brother Robin were taken into Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy to be raised alongside Nell Harcourt. Despite Robin's mischievous antics—such as pushing her into mud pies or pulling her curls—Lucy maintained her quiet, neat, and decorous nature. She adapted easily to Thirza's household, diligently performing chores, learning religious verses submissively, and quietly attending community gatherings like the Aid Society. When her uncle Richard Farrow passed away, leaving a trust fund for the twins, Lucy was delighted to learn that Grey Shutters would be her permanent home. During a severe severe hailstorm that terrified others, Lucy remained remarkably serene and held Nell's hand without panic. Even when she tumbled down the cellar stairs at eight years old, skinning her nose, or when Nell departed, her steady composure remained unshaken. As she grew older, her dependability, helpfulness, and mature caution made her a trusted caretaker around Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c1 P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)_
